answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 44193 Country: India Title: How to offer salah Question: I wanted to ask you that how to offer salah in a right way according to the holy Quran and Hadith in details. Answer ID: 44193 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 394/308/B=1434) First learn the fardh, wajib, sunnan salah and its etiquettes from any Alim and then offer salah paying full attention toward Allah. In-shaAllah, your salah shall be correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
